name: Names of the Nameless
disable: DC 26 Perception check to discern a name spoken by the nameless dead, or DC 28 Religion check (expert) to put the nameless dead to rest. Speaking three names aloud disables the haunt. A creature that speaks any other name aloud must succeed at a DC 28 Will save save or be Confused for 1 round.
reset: If the haunt is disabled, divine light washes through the area. Living creatures in the area regain 4d8 healing Hit Points, and undead creatures in the area take 4d8 vitality damage. The haunt deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.
routine: (1 action; auditory, divine, emotion, fear, mental) Spirits of the dead whisper their names into the minds of creatures in the room, dealing 2d10+11 mental damage (DC 28 basic Will save save). A creature that fails the save is also Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

items.name: Disappearing Door
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the room

---
Effect An illusory wall appears across the room's entrance. A creature who succeeds at DC 30 Perception check check disbelieves the illusion, allowing them to leave the area. The haunt then rolls initiative.

text: The voices of the nameless dead intrude into the minds of the living.
